scheduler_v3.name: SCHEDULER_V3_STEREO_SAFE
scheduler_v3.allocator: image_benchmark.allocate_progressive over cost_table_v3 (prefix fill METADATA → THUMBNAIL → COMPRESSED → FULL, stop at first misfit)

tiers.THUMBNAIL_PAIR: L+R rover thumbnails, NASA label estimate
tiers.COMPRESSED_STEREO_PAIR: L+R JPEG q50 ground re-encoding — SIMULATED PRODUCT TIER (not a NASA flight product)

scheduler_v3.metadata_bytes: length of the compact JSON acquisition record (run_phase3_baseline M11)

redundancy_constraints.scene_cluster: same (site, drive, pose) and pointing within 15.0°

mobilenetv2.preprocessing: features.to_work: PIL resize to 256×256 (BOX when downsampling, BICUBIC otherwise), scale by fixed 12-bit range /4095 (no per-image stretch) → Embedder: ×255 uint8, BICUBIC 224×224, 3-channel replicate, ImageNet mean/std; L2-normalised 1280-d output

embedding_change.novelty: 1 − max cosine similarity to earlier acquisitions within 3 sols (causal)
embedding_change.threshold_origin: median development stereo L/R distance (Phase 3.2); NOT recomputed on validation

traverse.sequence_definition: same (sol, sequence_id), sequence_id starts with 'trav', ≥ 10 acquisitions, ordered by capture time
traverse.EVERY_NTH_FRAME: frames 0, step, 2·step … with step = round(1/fraction), truncated to k
traverse.UNIFORM_DISTANCE: k equally spaced odometry targets; nearest unused frame per target
traverse.METADATA_POSITION: farthest-point sampling on Euclidean position distance, start frame 0
traverse.EMBEDDING_CHANGE: farthest-point sampling on embedding cosine distance, start frame 0
traverse.bytes: kept frames at FULL_STEREO_PAIR, the others at THUMBNAIL_PAIR (V3 pair costs)
traverse.visual_change_coverage: mean over frames of max cosine similarity to a kept frame

strategies_validation.THUMBNAIL_FIRST: inherent to V3 progressive fill (every thumbnail pair before any compressed pair); reported as V3·FIFO
strategies_validation.PHASH_CONSTRAINED: strategy_orders PHASH-REPRESENTATIVES with groups = pHash ≤ 10 bits AND same rover stop
strategies_validation.POSITION: traverse METADATA_POSITION (sequence-level method; not a global scheduler order)
strategies_validation.excluded: TELEMETRY-PRIORITY (dropped in Phase 3.2; telemetry is descriptive metadata only)

PRIMARY_position_plus_embedding_at_one_q.G4_gap: worst-sequence max spatial gap ≤ 2 × SEND_ALL worst-sequence max gap
PRIMARY_position_plus_embedding_at_one_q.PARTIALLY_GENERALIZES: G1 and G5 pass and exactly one of G2–G4 fails
PRIMARY_position_plus_embedding_at_one_q.justification: user's suggested criterion plus G1, which makes 'reduce bytes substantially' testable

rules.S1_scheduler_v3: GENERALIZES iff 0 monotonicity decreases (5 metrics × 6 orders × 80 budgets) AND stereo usable ≤ pairs with both eyes ≥ COMPRESSED

S2_quality_v2.fpr: GENERALIZES if validation FPR ≤ 2 × development (≤ 7.2 %); PARTIAL if ≤ 3 × (≤ 10.8 %); FAILS otherwise
S2_quality_v2.recall: OBVIOUS recall = 1.00 for every engineering family AND MODERATE recall within 0.15 (absolute) of development all-controls recall for every engineering family
S2_quality_v2.overall: GENERALIZES iff fpr GENERALIZES and recall passes; PARTIALLY if exactly one holds (or fpr PARTIAL)

rules.S3_constrained_phash: SAFE iff every constrained variant has false-merge (different scene) ≤ 0.05 AND duplicate retrieval ≥ 0.95; 'pHash alone unsafe' reproduces iff pHash-only false merge ≥ 0.50
rules.S4_embeddings: DISTINCT SIGNAL iff stereo p50 < consecutive p50 < random p50 (cosine) AND mean over LOCALIZED_STRUCTURE and TEXTURE_CHANGE at OBVIOUS of (embedding − pHash change detection) ≥ 0.30, with frozen development thresholds
rules.S5_position: GENERALIZES iff METADATA_POSITION at 1/4 has mean 5 m coverage ≥ 0.90 AND worst max gap ≤ 2 × SEND_ALL worst
rules.S6_generator: 0 contract violations required; violations are reported as generator failures, never regenerated

jev_optional_transfer_check.role: AUXILIARY DIAGNOSTIC — never validation truth, never tuning
